text: dsh-theme-palette 为 DSH 网页和桌面端提供可调配色。它通过客户端主题 token 覆盖层和设置页控制界面工作，包含黑白、暖砂、靛蓝、苔绿及自定义配色，可调整文字、侧栏、滚动条、开关与 Markdown 强调。配色引擎重建 OKLCH 色阶并求解对比度，设置保存在浏览器 localStorage，也可用短码导入导出。适合希望自定义 DSH 外观的用户，无需 API 密钥或外部服务。

dsh-theme-palette customizes DSH web and desktop colors with Mono, Warm, Indigo, Moss, and custom palettes. Settings tune text, sidebar, scrollbars, switches, and Markdown emphasis. Choices persist in localStorage and can be shared by code. No API key or external service is needed.
想把 DSH 的界面换成暖色或冷色主题。
DSH 有没有黑白、靛蓝或苔绿色的配色可选？
我想自己设定应用的背景色、文字色和强调色。
能不能让侧栏更浅或更深，并调整文字的着色强度？
Can I customize the colors and contrast of my DSH interface?
I want to save and share my theme settings between machines.
dsh-theme-palette 的功能「预设与自定义配色」：为 DSH 界面提供黑白、暖砂、靛蓝、苔绿和自定义配色，并适配浅色与深色模式。在设置页选择配色即可应用。
dsh-theme-palette 的功能「颜色控制」：设置页允许调整正文着色强度、侧栏表面深浅、滚动条、开关配色与 Markdown 强调显示，选择后即时更新界面。
dsh-theme-palette 的功能「配置分享」：插件可将当前主题设置编码为短码，也能预览并导入短码配置，包含自定义颜色。
dsh-theme-palette 的功能「浏览器端配置保存」：插件把配色和设置写入 localStorage，重新打开客户端时读取并恢复所选状态。
让 DSH 的浅色和深色界面都使用我选的主题色。
I want a theme that keeps working across light and dark mode.

dsh-theme-palette README · Compatibility：| Surface | Status |
|---|---|
| DSH desktop / web client | 0.2.x |
| Node.js | 22.19.0+ (on the 22.x line) or 24.0.0+ |
| Changes to host source | none |

The `engines` field of the package is `^22.19.0 || >=24.0.0` — the row above is the same requirement in prose.

The plugin only stacks colour tokens through `ctx.theme.overrideTokens`; it does not register a theme, patch the host, or touch the appearance preference.
dsh-theme-palette README · Install：```bash

dsh-theme-palette README · from npm：cd ~/.dsh/profiles/desktop
pnpm add dsh-theme-palette
```

To pin a version, use `pnpm add dsh-theme-palette@<version>` — [CHANGELOG.md](CHANGELOG.md) marks the sections that were never published to npm, so you do not pin one of those.
From a GitHub Release tarball: pick the asset on the [releases page](https://github.com/zuoyunlai/dsh-theme-palette/releases) and install it with `pnpm add <path-to-tgz>`.
dsh-theme-palette README · from npm：Then **restart the GUI** — a running process keeps the old module. Open it from avatar → Settings → **Color theme**.

dsh-theme-palette README · Configuration：| Item | Options |
|---|---|
| Palette | Mono · Warm sand · Indigo · Moss (thumbnails follow light/dark) |
| Strength | Quiet / Standard / Strong — how much body text follows the palette |
| Panel surfaces | Sidebar (Lighter / Same / Deeper). The right panel is never tinted — it is a full-height transparent overlay, so painting it would cover the conversation (the setting was removed in 1.9.10) |
| More options | Language, Markdown emphasis, scrollbars, switches/checks |
dsh-theme-palette README · Configuration：Every choice applies immediately and is stored in `localStorage`. Light/dark stays under the host’s Appearance control.

dsh-theme-palette README · Palette engine：```
OKLCH(L, C, hue) ──► gamut clamp (binary search on C) ──► sRGB hex
        ▲
        └── role chroma × intensity, then contrast solve on {canvas, card, sidebar, overlay}
```
dsh-theme-palette README · Palette engine：Design notes, per-component rationale and the contrast tables live in [docs/DESIGN.md](docs/DESIGN.md). Release history: [CHANGELOG.md](CHANGELOG.md).

dsh-theme-palette README · Development：```bash
npm run report                        # token report for every palette (add -- --hc for the high-contrast tier)
npm run sheet                         # palette board → tools/sheet.html
npm run shot-sheet                    # screenshot the board (headless Chrome/Edge)
npm run compare -- --dir tools/out/<run>   # diff against the local baseline

dsh-theme-palette README · Development：Screenshot regression has two layers: the palette board (no auth needed) and the real desktop window via CDP (`tools/shoot-desktop.mjs`, needs `--remote-debugging-port`). See [tools/README.md](tools/README.md).
dsh-theme-palette README · Pitfalls we hit：The five that surprised us most during the 1.7.0 audit — each one was found by a test, not by looking at screenshots.

dsh-theme-palette README · Pitfalls we hit：- **A white accent produced a white link** (1.13:1). The contrast solver only ever walked away from the background in one direction, so an accent brighter than the background kept moving toward white.
- **Picking a colour changed the page but not the panel.** The component subscribed to the palette id, which never changes when a colour does — React compared the snapshots, saw no difference, and skipped the re-render.
- **Sharing a configuration did not share the colours.** The short code carried the modes but not the three custom colours, so importing on another machine reported success and silently kept the local values.
- **"Not promised" is not "impossible".** The report called the dark module surfaces "surface-limited" because it compared the body target against the deepest one (800). But 800 reaches about 10.22:1 and 850 about 15.27:1 with a white foreground — above the 10:1 target — so nothing was ever unreachable; those surfaces simply were not promised. The report now separates the declared target, the physical ceiling and the policy exemption, and counts dark 800/850 as "out of policy" instead of "physically unreachable".

dsh-theme-palette README · Trade-offs：Other theme plugins in this ecosystem ship glass, wallpapers and animation. We deliberately do not:

dsh-theme-palette README · Trade-offs：- **No glass or wallpaper.** That race is won on screenshots; we would rather compete on proof.
- **No theme market, no AI colour generation.** Both introduce colours we cannot guarantee — the contrast solver is the asset, and feeding it unpredictable input spends it.
- **No more palettes.** Four presets plus a three-colour generator beats ten hand-picked ones; volume is not the moat.
- **No eye-care claims.** We report measured ratios on the surfaces text actually lands on, and say "out of policy" when a surface is not one we promise — a measurement, not an excuse.
